title.narrative: SR MDO and Suspilne: Ukrainian public service media 2024-2027
SR MDO och Suspilne: public service media i Ukraina 2024-2027

description.narrative:
Overall development objective:
Strengthening freedom of speech and media pluralism during the war and post-war recovery with reinforced public service media as a tool.
Project objective:
Reinforced, reliable, and trustworthy public service media that contributes to the Ukrainian news ecosystem by strenghtening regional communities, especially in remote areas.
Outcomes:
- Suspilne has improved capacity to remain a reliable and trustworthy public service provider in the media landscape through increased interaction with regional target audiences;
- Maintenance of the digital transformation and further development of the digital ecosystem for a larger public outreach;
- Enhanced effectiveness of Suspilne regional network through bringing of central office and branches to a single nationwide management system and corporate culture.

sector.narrative: Media and free flow of information

description.narrative: Project key results in numbers: • Training and education of 15 editors responsible for the development of a hyperlocal correspondents network was conducted in cooperation with SR MDO. • An online course in public service journalism and ethical AI was developed in cooperation with the Prometheus platform and SR MDO, to be used to train journalists in the hyperlocal network. • The premises of the Cherkasy branch were overhauled and renovated. In the first quarter of 2025, Khmelnytskyi branch was renovated. • Training for six editors in investigative environmental journalism was conducted with support from SR MDO, to strengthen Suspilnes production of environmental journalism. • A quantitative study of media consumption and perception of the Suspilne brand in Ukraine was conducted, to have a baseline reference to measure future project impact. • In 2024, Suspilne digital team increased its social media audience by more than 3 million, reaching a total of 13.5 million subscribers. • A 360 assessment of leadership competencies and values (LDA) by the Barrett Values Center was conducted. • Developed the Handbook of Architectural and Design Solutions and the Interior and Exterior Design Concept for the bureau of the national information network of JSC UA: PBC as part of the unified Style Guide.
